text:
Questions 21-25 
 
What is Rosie and Colin's opinion about each of the following aspects of human geography? 
 
Choose FIVE answers from the box and write the correct letter, A-G, next to Questions 
21-25. 
 
Aspects of human geography 
 
21. Population   ……………            A. The information given about this was too vague. 
 
22. Health   ……………                   B. This may not be relevant to their course. 
 
23. Economies   ……………           C. This will involve only a small number of statistics. 
 
24. Culture   ……………                  D. It will be easy to find facts about this. 
 
25. Poverty   ……………                 E. The facts about this may not be reliable 
                                   
                                                        F. No useful research has been done on this 
 
                                                        G. The information provided about this was interesting.
